recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce a separate CarePlan.activity.outcome CodeableConcept for this issue; any future cleanup of the legacy care-plan-activity-outcome value set or historical mappings should be handled under a dedicated follow-up issue.
issue_request: FHIR-10027 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive for DSTU2, asking to add an outcome under CarePlan.activity as a CodeableConcept so implementers could know the outcome of an intervention.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged implementation commit 0ce706f192a999ff2c605f513265344d6607f3d8 added CarePlan.activity.outcome as a 0..1 CodeableConcept with the CarePlanActivityOutcome binding in the then-authoritative CarePlan spreadsheet source. FHIR-10620 later added the example value set for that outcome binding.
additional_context: FHIR-26064 later reached Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and intentionally renamed CarePlan.activity.outcome to CarePlan.activity.performedActivity as a CodeableReference, separating activity performed from Goal.outcome. The combined branch already contains the FHIR-26064 reconciliation commit fdc52d56040442ba2ec231a5f6d2c2275972b05b and the related FHIR-39101 reconciliation for the current CarePlan activity shape. FHIR-45000 and FHIR-48415 later refined performedActivity wording/value-set examples and progress comments without reversing the rename.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current build-scoped CarePlan source is active in source/fhir.ini, maps old outcomeCodeableConcept/outcomeReference names to performedActivity, and defines CarePlan.activity.performedActivity as the approved CodeableReference association for completed or in-progress activities.
